brief.topic: Fussilat 41:34: repel evil with what is better
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Fussilat 41:34 asks us to answer bad with what is better, and 41:35 is honest that it takes patience.

hooks.text: When someone is unkind to you

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: When someone is unkind to you. / One ayah. One lesson.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.

resolved.arabic: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُۚ ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةࣱ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمࣱ ٣٤
resolved.english: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend
resolved.transliteration: Wala tastawee alhasanatu wala alssayyiatu idfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu faitha allathee baynaka wabaynahu AAadawatun kaannahu waliyyun hameemun

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.

resolved.arabic: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمࣲ ٣٥
resolved.english: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]
resolved.transliteration: Wama yulaqqaha illa allatheena sabaroo wama yulaqqaha illa thoo haththin AAatheemin

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / The lesson / The ayah sets the good and the bad side by side and asks us to respond with what is better. The next ayah is honest about the cost: it takes patience. That makes it a goal to grow into, one response at a time.
